scenarios.description: A valid US customer record is processed correctly.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The customer record is transformed and output with the customer_name_upper as 'JOHN DOE' and signup_year as 2020.
scenarios.title: Valid US Customer Data

scenarios.description: A customer record with a non-US country is filtered out.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The customer record is filtered out and not included in the output.
scenarios.title: Non-US Customer Data

scenarios.description: A customer record with a null customer_name is processed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The transformation should handle the null customer_name gracefully, potentially resulting in a null or empty customer_name_upper.
scenarios.title: Null Customer Name

scenarios.description: A customer record with the maximum boundary value for customer_id is processed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The customer record is processed correctly with the maximum customer_id value.
scenarios.title: Boundary Customer ID

scenarios.description: A customer record with leading and trailing spaces in customer_name is processed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The customer_name is trimmed and converted to uppercase, resulting in 'ALICE WONDERLAND'.
scenarios.title: Customer Name Trimming and Uppercase
